value.rationale: Two-atom positive measures are the first genuinely interacting atomic case excluded from the leading 2026 Mellin-admissible spectral theorem. An irrational logarithmic ratio forces the full disk in the Fredholm essential spectrum, whereas rational ratios yield exact polynomial regions that can be noncircular. The conclusion is a natural complete sharp classification and supplies test cases for essential-spectrum functional-calculus claims, not a relabeling of the one-atom disk.
